results.title: WhatsApp, Telegram users to face mandatory SIM binding from Jan 2027
results.description: Daijiworld Media Network - New Delhi New Delhi, Oct 23: Millions of Indians using WhatsApp, Telegram and other messaging platforms will have to comply with new SIM-binding rules from January 1, 2027, following a directive issued by the Department of Telecommunications (DoT).
